sources.authors_or_organization: DeepSeek-AI / deepseek-harness contributors; vendored Cordis package credits Shigma where applicable
sources.date_note: Pinned repository commit date, not a claim about this file's last modification or individual authorship.

claims.claim: Structural owners can join already-started cleanup via effectInertia.
Child disposal is parent-owned and waits lifecycle inertia.
Async next is guarded before invocation; a pending next is awaited and its disposer collected.
Effect wrapper registration precedes setup; same effect group cleanup reverses and chains; errors may short-circuit a chain.
Committed providers retained until dependent cleanup; top-level disposers start through Promise.all; cleanup errors are logged before lifecycle releases dependents.

limitations: Error-to-settlement trace assumes logger itself does not throw.
No real resource cleanup, external termination, or crash recovery proved.
Grouped reverse cleanup is not global sequential completion.
sources.validation: Static read only; no third-party repository code or test executed.
